newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for March 17.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for March 17.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open on Monday, the Communications and Transport Ministry said in its 1500 local/2100 GMT daily meteorological report.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.

Disperse clouds and possible rains along Baja California, Sonora and Sinaloa state coasts. Isolated storms later in the day and maximum winds between 10 and 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 19 miles per hour) with waves three to six feet high.

Weak cold front in the northeast gulf region with light rains in Tamaulipas and northern Veracruz state coasts. Winds between 10 to 20 knots (19 to 38 km/11 to 22 miles per hour) with waves three to six feet high.
Isolated clouds, hot and moderate eastern and southeastern winds from 20 to 30 km per hour.
